primary_sources.finding: The original single-participant LibriBrain paper links the author data repository pnpl/LibriBrain. Table 2 reports 93 sessions: 91 training, one validation and one test.

LibriBrain100 is the union of LibriBrain and LibriBrain2. Its Broad component adds subjects 1–32 with two Sherlock chapter blocks each, distinct from the original subject-0 cohort. LibriBrain100 is not a third independent collection.
